experiment: MCRL fixed-coefficient scaffold evaluation, five active CCI predictors plus three reused scaffold GINs
initialization: Unsupervised ChemBERTa only; other layers fresh. No SMRT-supervised weights or optimizer loaded.
selection: Scaffold validation MAE only. Max 200 epochs; early stopping patience 20; original ReduceLROnPlateau.
transform: PowerTransformer and tail quantile fitted on scaffold train only.
fusion: Historical coefficients fixed before new training; no refitting on scaffold validation or test.
test_use: Final predictions after all five members have completed validation-based selection.
reuse: Three archived scaffold GIN val/test predictions, ID/SMILES/RT/hash checked; no GIN retraining or re-inference.
